keys.{all_tasks_done_escape}: All tasks are done! The exits are open, escape through any of them!
keys.{board_hint}: The torn plan pieces get pinned here
keys.{book_status_carry}: Logbook found: take it to the desk in the staff room
keys.{cmd_seed_desc}: Shows the seed of the current school
keys.{cmd_start_desc}: Starts the game (host) or starts a vote to begin
keys.{cmd_testboss_desc}: Host only, for testing: play as the monster right away (type it again to stop)
keys.{door_locked}: Locked. You need the master key.
keys.{find_tasks_banner}: Find a way out. Press @key_4@ to see your tasks.
keys.{found_page}: You found a piece of the evacuation plan!
keys.{host_menu_text}: Choose the seed of the school (the same seed always builds the same school), then start. Other players can also type /start to vote.
keys.{key_status_carry}: Key found: unlock the principal's office
keys.{key_status_search}: Search the corridor lockers for the master key
keys.{lobby_hint}: Waiting for the host. Type /start to vote.
keys.{no_seed_yet}: No school has been built yet.
keys.{player_found_page}: %s found a piece of the evacuation plan!
keys.{seed_announce}: The school was built from seed %d.
keys.{start_votes_disabled}: The host has turned /start votes off.
keys.{task_done_by_other}: Someone else finished the task you were tracking.
keys.{tasks_panel_text}: Click a task to get an arrow pointing the way to it.
keys.{testboss_off}: Test mode over, back to the lobby.
keys.{testboss_on}: Test mode: you are the monster. The round will not end on its own; type /testboss again to stop.
keys.{testboss_wait}: The round is ending, try again in the lobby.
keys.{they_are_escaping}: The doors are open. Do not let them escape!
keys.{vote_passed}: The vote passed. The round begins!
keys.{vote_text}: %s wants to start the game. Start now?
keys.{you_are_monster}: You are a monster now. Hunt them down. Press @key_8@ to scream.
